name: ThunderBolt

images.credit: Ryry17354 at English Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 3.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Network.Technology: Dual-band CDMA/EVDO Rev. A/EHRPD (800 1900 MHz), LTE 700 MHz (band 13)

Platform.Operating system: Android 2.2 "Froyo" with HTC Sense 2.0, Upgradeable to Android 4.0.4 Ice Cream Sandwich with HTC Sense 3.6

Display.Display: 4.27 in diagonal, 1.67:1 aspect ratio widescreen, TFT LCD capacitive touchscreen, 480x800 resolution at 215 ppi (0.38 Mpx), Corning Gorilla Glass, crack and scratch resistant

Cameras.Rear camera: 8.0 Mpx with autofocus, 2 LED flash, with 720p HD video capture

Connectivity.Connectivity: CDMA 800/1900 MHz EVDO Rev. A, 4G LTE 700 MHz, Wi-Fi (802.11b/g/n); Bluetooth 2.1 (upgradeable to 3.0) with A2DP stereo and EDR; A-GPS; FM tuner with RDS, 3.5 mm stereo audio jack, Micro-USB, Mobile Hotspot
